description: NaCaBe₂B₂O₆F crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.63 Å. There is one shorter (2.43 Å) and one longer (2.56 Å) Na-F bond length. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six BeO₃F tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.43 Å. There are two inequivalent Be sites. In the first Be site, Be is bonded to three O and one F atom to form BeO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one BeO₃F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-74°. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.62 Å. The Be-F bond length is 1.68 Å. In the second Be site, Be is bonded to three O and one F atom to form BeO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one BeO₃F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 63-77°. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.63 Å. The Be-F bond length is 1.66 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.38 Å) and two longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond lengths. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Be, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Be, and one B atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Be, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Be, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Be, and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Be, and one B atom. F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two Be atoms.
